name: 173.3 — a widget in front of or behind its siblings
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 173.3: widget:raise() and widget:lower() reorder siblings, widget:z(n) holds a band through later raises and gives back the band and the place behind the sibling it followed, the order writes refuse on a root, the HUD, a column's child and a region, and a dropdown's list opens over a surface at the top band.
